settings.purpose: the model this agent runs, so that changing it is a setting and not a new version. It must read text and hold a long request in one context. The package names no model of its own: absent, the model the host runs agents on (AGENT_MODEL) is used, and with neither the job is refused in words. A name starting google-vertex-anthropic/ is Claude on Google Vertex AI, paid for with a token from the machine it runs on, and the credential is then where to call, written <project>/<location>; a bare name is a Gemini model reached at Google, and the credential is then its key; any other name with a provider in front is refused in words

directories.purpose: the request, the draft, the blanks and the builder's verdict for each job
